alt: Rows of the Postgres table source_products (category, name, description, price, amount) are read one by one; process_product composes full_description from category, name and description, computes total_value as price times amount, embeds the description with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and writes each row to coco_examples_v1.output with pgvector; after an UPDATE to the Wireless Headphones description only that row is re-embedded, and the query "wireless headphones" returns Electronics | Wireless Headphones | 50 | 9999.5.
